Zombs Recorder

Records the ZombsRoyale games you choose and uploads them to train a game AI. Setup takes about 3 minutes, once.

  • Mac with macOS 14 or newer
  • Google Chrome
  • ZombsRoyale in a Chrome tab

Put the app in Applications

  1. Double-click Zombs Recorder Kit.zip to unzip it (skip this if it is already a folder).
  2. Drag ZombsRecorder into the Applications folder in the Finder sidebar.

Open it (macOS asks once)

  1. In Applications, double-click ZombsRecorder. macOS says it can't check the app: click Done (or OK).
  2. Open System Settings → Privacy & Security, scroll down, and click Open Anyway next to ZombsRecorder.
  3. Enter your Mac password, then click Open Anyway (or Open) once more.

This happens because the app is shared privately rather than through the App Store. Alternatively, paste this into Terminal once:
xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/ZombsRecorder.app

Finish the setup window

A Zombs Recorder window opens by itself.

  1. Screen recording: click Allow Screen Recording…, then Open System Settings. Switch on ZombsRecorder, and click Quit & Reopen when macOS asks. The setup window comes back; carry on there.
  2. Uploads: already set up ✓
  3. Game area: open ZombsRoyale in Chrome. In the preview, the red line should sit on the top edge of the game, just below Chrome's tabs and address bar. If it doesn't, drag the slider.
  4. Click Done.

Record your games

Mode Before each game, click the record icon in the menu bar (top right of the screen) and choose Mode → Solo, Duo or Squad. The icon shows the current mode. = Start: in the game, press = about 10 seconds before you join a match. You hear a tick, and a timer appears in the menu bar. = Stop: when you are back in the main menu after the match, press = again. You hear a pop.

One game per recording. Leave the app open: it uploads each game in the background between matches, never during one.

Good to know

  • = only starts or stops recording while the ZombsRoyale tab is in front. Everywhere else it types “=” as usual.
  • Nothing happened when I pressed =? Click inside the game first. A low “bonk” sound means it couldn't start: click the record icon in the menu bar to see why.
  • Only the game area is recorded, and only between the two presses. Chrome's tabs, address bar and bookmarks are never recorded.
  • Recordings shorter than 20 seconds are thrown away. Started one by mistake? Use Discard this recording in the menu.
  • If you close the game tab, or a recording runs for 45 minutes, it saves and stops by itself.
  • A game uses about 120 MB per minute until it has uploaded; then it is deleted from your Mac.
  • macOS may occasionally ask whether ZombsRecorder can keep recording your screen. Click Allow.
  • To see this guide again: record icon in the menu bar → Setup guide.
  • To remove it: record icon → Quit Zombs Recorder, then drag ZombsRecorder from Applications to the Bin.
